title: Courtyard Turns 5: The Biggest Pulls, New Packs, and a Birthday Livestream
summary: Courtyard celebrates 5 years with 3 new Sweet Mode Pokémon packs, $5K in livestream giveaways, and a look back at the biggest card pulls in platform history.
body_markdown:
Back in 2021, a small group of[Pokémon](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=pkmn) fans got together and imagined a new way for collectors to chase pocket monsters. Today, Courtyard turns five.


Over the past half decade, we’ve expanded from Pokémon to other TCG like[Magic: The Gathering](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=magic_the_gathering) ,[sports cards](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=sports) ,[watches](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=watches) ,[comics](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=comics) ,[coins](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=coins) , and more, giving collectors access to a dozen different categories. To celebrate, we’re upping the ante.


Join the team at Courtyard for a birthday party that includes a six-hour livestream, three new Pokémon packs, and five bounties worth a combined $8,125 in fair market value, and follow along as we reminisce about five years of jaw-dropping pulls, one-of-a-kind collectibles, big-time peer-to-peer marketplace sales, and so much more.


Now who wants some party favors?!


## **What Is Courtyard?**


For those of you that are just meeting us for the first time, allow us to introduce ourselves.


Courtyard brings the fun and thrill of discovery back to shopping by allowing collectors to discover exciting, desirable items—from trading cards and comic books to luxury watches and sneakers—[all of which are backed by physical vaulted inventory](https://courtyard.io/blog/post/is-courtyard-io-legit-heres-what-you-need-to-know) , bridging physical asset ownership with digital convenience. By combining the security of vaulting infrastructure with more than 100 different seamless digital packs to rip, real-time trading on a peer-to-peer marketplace, and guaranteed buybacks that enhance each pull, Courtyard provides a modernized collectibles experience tailored for both casual fans and serious collectors alike.


Chasing a vintage[Michael Jordan](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Michael%20Jordan&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) ,[Kobe Bryant](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Kobe%20Bryant&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) , or[Shaq](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Shaquille%20O%27Neal&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) insert? We’ve got ‘em. If[Monkey D. Luffy](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=onepiece) is more your style, we’ve got plenty of One Piece cards, too. And for those that go beyond cards to sneakers, ancient coins, and watches, we’ve got packs featuring real, authenticated[Nike Dunks](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Nike%20Dunks&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) ,[coins from the Roman empire](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Roman%20Coin&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) , and[Patek Philippe](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Patek%20Philippe&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) watches waiting to be pulled.


## **Courtyard’s 5th Birthday Livestream Schedule**


We’re ready to party nonstop. Are you?


From 12:00 p.m. through 6:15 p.m. Eastern on Tuesday, November 17th, Courtyard will feature a live stream on its[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@courtyard_io) ,[Twitch](https://www.twitch.tv/courtyard_io) ,[X](https://x.com/Courtyard_io) (Twitter), and[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/courtyard.io/) that follows the platform’s growth from Pokémon to[hockey](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=baseball) ,[baseball](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=baseball) ,[comics](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=comics) , and more—before a grand finale caps off the stream. Stay tuned for $5,000 in giveaways, special guests, live games, and, of course, pack rips.


Check out the full schedule below:


- **12:00-12:30 PM, Opening:** Courtyard's founding team covers the origin story, the earliest designs and the first packs, plus memorable pulls and footage from the early office.
- **12:30-1:10 PM, Pokémon:** Jake and Jacob look back at where Courtyard started, the biggest Pokémon pulls and live[Sweet Mode](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=pokemon) rips.
- **1:10-1:50 PM, Soccer:** John covers the World Cup cycle, young stars against legends and a round of "Start, Bench, Sell."
- **1:50-2:30 PM, Hockey:** Jim and Drew talk hockey collecting culture and play "Buy, Sell, Hold."
- **2:30-3:10 PM, Comics:** Sunil covers comic grails, Marvel against DC and the "First Appearance Challenge."
- **3:10-3:50 PM, Coins:** Matt covers ancient coins and rarity, then plays "Guess the Year" and "$100 vs. $10,000."
- **3:50-4:35 PM, Baseball and One Piece:** Hiram connects the two hobbies with "Would You Rather" and a One Piece starter guide.
- **4:35-5:15 PM, Watches:** Nico covers where luxury and collectibles overlap, plays "Watch or Card?" and talks about what is next for Courtyard.
- **5:15-5:55 PM, Football:** Taylor Lewan of Bussin' With The Boys joins for an NFL card draft and reactions to the weekend's games.
- **5:55-6:15 PM, Finale:** A recap montage, the final giveaway tally, one last big giveaway and a community toast with Nico


## **Giveaways and the Birthday Wheel**


More than $5,000 in giveaways will be handed out during the stream, with a chance for collectors to win every 15 minutes across all categories. Prizes will come from the Birthday Wheel, which has 14 (or more) scheduled spins, plus a grand finale spin. The wheel includes:


- $100, $500, and $1,000 in Courtyard credit
- A free pack and a $250 pack
- A mystery slab
- ‘Double the Prize’
- ‘Rip It or Ship It’
- The Birthday Jackpot, which grows by $100 each time it is missed
- The Grand Birthday Grail


## **The “Party of Five” Packs**


Three Pokémon packs drop at the start of the livestream and will stay live while inventory lasts, and you don’t want to miss them. Select “Party of Five” packs will feature Sweet Mode, with a raised floor of 80% and an increased ceiling of 4x the pack’s price.


Not only are these packs extra sweet, they come with a chance at pulling a bounty card worth Courtyard Points, too. Every bounty is worth 50,000 Courtyard Points, a value of $250. Pull and hold one of those cards for 24 hours and you’ll receive the Courtyard Points in your Courtyard account, where they can be spent on packs of your choosing.

## **The Milestone Moments—and Biggest Pulls—in Courtyard’s History**


Since Nicolas le Jeune and Paulin Andurand launched Courtyard in 2021, we’ve shared plenty of unforgettable moments with collectors across the globe. Today’s big event got us thinking back on all of the special moments along the way. Here are five of our favorites:


- **March 2022:** Courtyard's first drop, “Back to School,” featured roughly 1,000 PSA-graded Pokémon cards—and sold out in under four hours.
- **March 2024:** Courtyard launched its vending machines, featuring packs of authenticated, graded collectibles. A 2003 Aquapolis #H29[Umbreon](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Umbreon&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) - Holo e-Card Symbol (PSA 10 GEM MINT) valued at $11,490 was pulled later out of a Courtyard pack later that year.
- **February 2025:** The 1 millionth pack was opened on Courtyard. The milestone was reached via a[Pokémon Master Pack](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine/pkmn-master-pack) featuring a 2016 Pokémon XY Promo #218[Ash-Greninja EX](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Ash-Greninja%20EX&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) - Holo World Hobby Fair (PSA 9 MINT).
- **January 2026:** Courtyard’s first-ever Limited Drop debuted on the platform, giving Pokémon fans a chance to collect their favorite elements via the Fire & Water Pack.
- **October 2026:** A 2018 Panini Prizm Stained Glass #SG-8[Josh Allen](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Josh%20Allen&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) Gold Mojo (PSA 10 GEM MINT) valued at $42,398 was pulled out of a Courtyard pack.


None of the above would be possible without you, the collectors—and there are a whole lot of you getting in on the fun over at Courtyard. Here’s a quick look at some of the numbers that make up the Courtyard community:


- **More than 16 million** packs have been opened
- **1.6 million+** peer-to-peer marketplace sales have taken place between collectors
- **More than 1 million** collectibles have been redeemed and shipped to collectors' doors


Here’s what **Courtyard’s Founder and CEO, Nicolas le Jeune** , had to say about turning a dream into a powerful platform for collectors:


“Five years ago, we set out to build something different. What started with Pokémon has grown into something much bigger, and we’re only scratching the surface of what’s possible. We believe the future of shopping should be more entertaining, interactive, and rewarding, and we’re excited to keep pushing the boundaries of what that experience can look like”


### **The Biggest Pulls in Courtyard’s History**


Plenty of collectors on Courtyard have pulled grails that they now proudly display at their homes, offices, and more, but some collectors have pulled life-changing hits. Here are the five biggest in Courtyard’s history.


1. **$42,398 — 2018 Panini Prizm Stained Glass #SG-8**[Josh Allen](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Josh%20Allen&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **Gold Mojo (PSA 10)**
2. **$40,492 — 2002 Pokémon Neo Destiny #109**[Shining Mewtwo](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Shining%20Mewtwo&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **1st Edition Holo (PSA 10)**
3. **$40,187 — 2002 Pokémon Neo Destiny #109**[Shining Mewtwo](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Shining%20Mewtwo&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **1st Edition Holo (PSA 10)**
4. **$38,324 — 2002 Pokémon Neo Destiny #109**[Shining Mewtwo](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Shining%20Mewtwo&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **1st Edition Holo (PSA 10)**
5. **$37,427 — 1999 Pokémon Game #4**[Charizard](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Charizard&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **1st Edition Holo (PSA 9)**


Our favorite runner up is a pair of deadstock[1985 Air Jordan 1 OG Chicago sneakers](https://courtyard.io/blog/post/chasing-the-1985-air-jordan-1-inside-courtyards-nba-opening-week-pack?d565656f_page=2) that have a fair market value of $30,000—and were pulled out of a pack that cost just $65!


## **The Biggest Peer-to-Peer Sales Between Collectors on Courtyard**


On Courtyard, it’s not just about the thrill of ripping packs. Looking to find your grail? There are plenty of other collectors looking to sell their collectibles on our marketplace, which has 0% sell fees. Maybe that’s why one collector parted with a $90k Rolex Cosmograph Daytona.


Here are the highest peer-to-peer sales to date:


1. **$90,000:** Rolex Cosmograph Daytona 40mm 18kt Yellow Gold Turquoise Blue Dial
2. **$39,393.65:** 1999 Pokémon Game #4 Charizard 1st Edition Holo (PSA 8)
3. **$28,242:** 1999 Pokémon Game #4 Charizard 1st Edition Holo (PSA 7)
4. **$27,396:** 2006 Pokémon EX Legend Maker #90 Regice Holo Gold Star (PSA 10)
5. **$26,810:** 2013 XY Promo #230 Poncho-Wearing Pikachu, Rayquaza Poncho Pikachu Box (BGS 10 Pristine)
6. **$25,000:** 2019 Panini Crown Royale Kaboom! #19 Stephen Curry (PSA 10)

From 12:00 p.m. through 6:15 p.m. Eastern on Tuesday, November 17th, you can join our live stream on its[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@courtyard_io) ,[Twitch](https://www.twitch.tv/courtyard_io) ,[X](https://x.com/Courtyard_io) (Twitter), and[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/courtyard.io/) . Thanks for an incredible five years. Cheers to many, many more!


## **FAQ:**


### **What is Sweet Mode on Courtyard?"**


Sweet Mode is a Courtyard pack mechanic featuring a raised floor (guaranteeing cards worth at least 80% of the pack price) and a 4× ceiling with published odds and no bust pulls.


### **Can I ship cards pulled on Courtyard to my home?**


Yes. Every card pulled on Courtyard is an authenticated physical item vaulted under custody. Collectors can redeem their cards at any time for direct worldwide doorstep delivery.
